encoding.layout: 8-bit greyscale, 4 * size wide: R0 G0 B0 A0 R1 ... per row
encoding.r: 1 + the row of `grounds` reaching the texel (0 none)
encoding.g: 1 + another row reaching it (grown wider, the first row wins)
encoding.grounds: [cx, cy, angle, p1, p2, p3, surface, marking, shape]: the centre in m from the tile's north-west corner (x east, y north), the long axis (rad from east, ccw); rect/free p1, p2 = half length, half width; stadium p1 = half straight, p2 = outer radius, p3 = band width
